questions.question: The source directly links elliptic functions to the proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Clarify the distinction between elliptic functions and elliptic curves and agree precise wording for both editions.

localizations.source: The source directly links elliptic functions to the proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Clarify the distinction between elliptic functions and elliptic curves and agree precise wording for both editions.
localizations.ru: В исходнике эллиптические функции прямо связываются с доказательством Великой теоремы Ферма. Уточнить различие между эллиптическими функциями и эллиптическими кривыми и согласовать точную формулировку обеих версий.

questions.resolution: Both editions distinguish elliptic functions from the elliptic curves used in [Wiles’s proof](https://annals.math.princeton.edu/1995/141-3/p01).

questions.question: Verify the 1821 conversion and name change, dates and categories of academy memberships, and the relationships with those listed as pupils.

localizations.source: Verify the 1821 conversion and name change, dates and categories of academy memberships, and the relationships with those listed as pupils.
localizations.ru: Сверить дату принятия лютеранства и смены имени 1821 года, даты и виды академического членства и характер отношений с перечисленными «учениками».

questions.resolution: The conversion and name change are now dated to 1825, and the 1829 full professorship is stated. Hermite, Liouville and Cayley are no longer described as Jacobi’s direct pupils; both editions refer instead to the influence of his lectures, correspondence and writings.

questions.question: Clarify the attribution and priority of the change-of-variables method: the source’s simultaneous-with wording does not assert joint authorship.

localizations.source: Clarify the attribution and priority of the change-of-variables method: the source’s simultaneous-with wording does not assert joint authorship.
